title: Benzothiadiazole-based donor–acceptor covalent organic framework for photocatalytic hydrogen generation
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01764A, Paper
Amit Nagar, Gulshan Singh, Akhtar Alam, Pradip Pachfule, C. M. Nagaraja
Rational design of benzothiadiazole-based donor (D)–acceptor (A) covalent organic framework for photocatalytic hydrogen evolution is presented.
